claims.subject: Centralized Scheduler
claims.evidence_quote: In this paper, we assume that we have a centralized scheduler.

claims.subject: Centralized Scheduler
claims.evidence_quote: At the beginning of each synchronous round, it decides for each amoebot (i) which bonds to release, (ii) which movements to perform, and (iii) which bonds to reestablish.

claims.subject: Meta-module
claims.evidence_quote: Our meta-modules implement all aforementioned movement primitives without any constraints, i.e., they perform them in place.

claims.subject: Crystalline Atoms
claims.evidence_quote: From all aforementioned models, crystalline atoms (Rus & V ona, 1999), telecubes (Suh et al., 2002; Vassilvitskii et al., 2002b), and prismatic cubes (Weller et al., 2009) are the closest to our joint movement extension.

claims.subject: Amoebot
claims.evidence_quote: In contrast to amoebots, a line of robots cannot reconfigure to any other shape since each pair of robots can only have a single point of contact (Aloupis et al., 2009).

claims.subject: Distributed Solutions
claims.evidence_quote: We leave the design of distrib - uted solutions for future work.

claims.subject: Reconfiguration
claims.evidence_quote: The reversibility of valid movements immediately implies that each reconfiguration is reversible, i.e., if there is a reconfiguration (S0 ,..., SF ), then there is also a recon - figuration (SF ,..., S0 ).
